To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

5 HT depolarized 46% of principal cells, but had no effect on the other 54%; the 5 HT receptor mediating depolarization is a 5 HT1 receptor, and the one mediating hyperpolarization is a presynaptic 5 HT1A autoreceptor.

5 HT depolarized 46% of principal cells and hyperpolarized 11% of principal cells; 5 HT depolarization was mimicked by DOI, and blocked by ketaserin, and 5 HT hyperpolarization was mimiced by dipropyl-5-carboxamidotryptamime and blocked by tetrodoxin and bicuculine.
5 HT depolarized 46% of dopamine-containing principal cells, and hyperpolarized 28% of these cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the actions of 5 HT on ventral tegmentum neurons.
the actions of 5 hydroxtryptamine and related drugs on the ventral tegmental and substantia nigral dopamine systems.
the effects of 5 hydroxyltryptamine (serotonin, 5 HT) on ventral tegmentum dopamine neurons in vitro.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
5HT has a complex effect on the activity of dopaminergic neurons in the VTA.
5HT has a mixed action on VTA DA cells, with some cells being depolarized and others being hyperpolarized.
5 HT has no effect on the firing rate of principal cells but may have a modulatory role on the activity of GABAergic neurons in the VTA and SNc.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the actions of 5 HT on VTA neurons are complex, and that the effects of 5 HT are not uniform in different subpopulations of VTA cells.
the effects of 5 HT on VTA DA cells are complex, but that 5 HT has an overall inhibitory effect on these cells.
5 HT depolarizes or hyperpolarizes both dopamine-containing principal and non dopamine containing secondary cells of the ventral tegmental A and substantia nigral zona compacta.
The main takeaway from our work is that
5 HT can depolarize and hyperpolarize neurons in the ventral tegmental and zona compacta areas of the substantia nigra in a dose dependent manner.
serotonin can have a direct excitatory effect on dopaminergic cells, and this may be important for understanding some of the effects of serotonin.
